# Dialog

A modal window for a short task or a decision; a sheet on phones.

- Status: implemented
- Category: container
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “dialog-modal”; HTML `<dialog> opened with showModal()`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **scrim**: Dims the page; inert behind.
- **surface**: Overlay surface, elevation 3.
- **title**: h2 labelling the dialog.
- **body**: Content.
- **actions**: Primary and secondary buttons.
- **close** (optional): A labelled close button.

## Variants

- `dialog`: Centred.
- `alert`: role=alertdialog for a decision with consequences.
- `sheet`: From the bottom on a phone; centred on desktop.

## States

- `closed`
- `open`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Escape | Closes. |
| Tab, Shift+Tab | Stay inside the dialog. |
| Enter | Activates the focused button. |

## Accessibility

- Role: dialog / alertdialog
- Name: aria-labelledby its title.
- Focus moves to the first useful control, and back to the opener on close.
- The page behind is inert.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap (A)
- 2.4.3 Focus Order (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) (AA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<button
  type="button"
  class="nd-button nd-button--secondary"
  data-open-dialog="ex-dialog"
>
  Open a dialog
</button>
<dialog class="nd-dialog" id="ex-dialog" aria-labelledby="ex-dialog-title">
  <h2 class="nd-dialog__title" id="ex-dialog-title">Leave the form?</h2>
  <p>What you typed is not sent.</p>
  <div class="nd-dialog__actions">
    <button
      type="button"
      class="nd-button nd-button--secondary"
      data-close-dialog
    >
      Stay
    </button>
    <button type="button" class="nd-button" data-close-dialog>Leave</button>
  </div>
</dialog>
```
